class.name: VECSComponent
class.brief_description: A field-level accessor for one component instance attached to an entity.
class.description:
[b]VECSComponent[/b] is a transient accessor obtained from [method VECSEntity.get_component]. Reads and writes go straight to the entity's archetype column, so every [method set_field] is reflected immediately and marks the row as changed (which feeds [code].changed()[/code] queries).
The accessor stays valid for the lifetime of the entity; after a structural change the underlying storage may move, so re-fetch the accessor if you keep it across such changes.

method.name: get_field
method.description: Returns the value of the field [param name]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the field does not exist on this component type.

method.name: get_fields
method.description: Returns every field of this component as a [Dictionary] of name to value.

method.name: get_type_name
method.description: Returns the name of the component type this accessor refers to.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying entity is alive and still has this component.

method.name: set_field
method.description: Writes [param value] into the field [param name] and marks the row changed. No-op if the field does not exist or the entity is dead.
